data.name: Flatpack: Furniture Simulator
data.detailed_description:
Roadmap


About the Game

In Flatpack, you are the freshly minted CEO of your own furniture assembly company. Your mission: expertly assemble your customers’ new furniture and try your best to leave their apartment in one piece. Along the way, turn boxes full of boards and screws into fully functional, good-looking pieces of furniture.

Key Features

Build Step by Step
You won’t just place furniture into rooms — you’ll build it from the ground up. Every single piece is put together using your tools.

Physics-Based Chaos

Every board, screw, and dowel follows its own physics. Watch how hard you hit things, or the chair might go flying across the room.

Study the Manual

Every set comes with its own manual. Some are certainly more helpful than others. While manuals are usually a help, in Flatpack they can sometimes become a challenge in their own right.

Set Up Your Own Office

You’re not just slaving away for your customers’ dream apartments. Set up your own office exactly the way you like it. You can order, assemble, and place furniture in your very own four walls too.

More Features

  • Solo or Online Co-op

    Tackle missions alone, or grab up to three friends to complete jobs together in online co-op. Communicate clearly, or you might accidentally nail each other’s hands to a bookshelf. Just an occupational hazard.

  • Progressive Career Mode

    Start out in your small village office and work your way up to becoming a 5-star assembly giant in the world’s biggest cities.

  • Buy Licenses

    Expand your portfolio by purchasing licenses for new furniture. Once you have the license, you can accept jobs involving that piece of furniture.

  • Improve Your Skills

    Spend your skill points to complete jobs even faster and more effectively.

Early Alpha

Flatpack is currently in an early stage of development. Even so, we wanted to take the opportunity to share our idea with the community already. Your feedback matters to us! The best place to share it and see updates on the game is our Discord or our social media channels! We’d love to see you there.

data.short_description: Flatpack is a wildly chaotic furniture assembly simulator. Play with up to 4 people, decipher assembly instructions, hammer in dowels, drive screws in wherever they (probably) belong, and turn your assembly company into the biggest one out there!
data.supported_languages: English, German, French, Spanish - Spain, Simplified Chinese, Italian, Czech, Japanese, Polish, Swedish

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-Bit)
  • Processor: Dual-Core, 2,0 GHz (z. B. Intel Core i3-4130 / AMD FX-4300)
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Vulkan-1.2-fähige GPU mit 2 GB VRAM (z. B. Intel UHD 620, GeForce GTX 750 Ti, Radeon R7 260)
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-Bit)
  • Processor: Quad-Core, 3,0 GHz (z. B. Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600)
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 1060 / Radeon RX 580 (4 GB VRAM) oder besser
  • Storage: 500 MB available space

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 11 (Big Sur) or later
  • Processor: Apple M1, or Intel Core i5 (2017 or newer, quad-core)
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Apple M1 integrated GPU, or Intel Iris Plus Graphics 655 / AMD Radeon Pro 555 (Intel Macs)
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
mac_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: macOS 13 (Ventura) or later
  • Processor: Apple M1 Pro/M2 or better, or Intel Core i7
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Apple M1 Pro GPU or better, or AMD Radeon Pro 5300M / equivalent
  • Storage: 500 MB available space

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 20.04 LTS 64-bit or equivalent
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-7100 or AMD Ryzen 3 1200 (or older equivalent quad-core)
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 650 / AMD Radeon RX 550
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
linux_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Ubuntu 22.04 LTS 64-bit or newer
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 or AMD Ryzen 5
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 960 / AMD equivalent (Vulkan 1.2)
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
